_how_this_works: Keywords are set PER REEL, the same way Julia sets them in LinkDM. The same word can mean different things on different days, so nothing is assumed. Her twice-daily sweep reads LinkDM and writes each new reel's entry into 'posts' below. A reel with no entry is left completely alone.
_pilot: Empty, so every reel that has a mapping is worked on. While pilot_post_ids has anything in it, ONLY those posts are touched - put an id back in it to test on one reel.
_threads_reply_note: How a LinkDM message becomes a Threads reply. LinkDM allows 900 characters; Threads allows 500 and counts every URL in full. So the message is cut, never truncated. Keep: the thing the reel promised (the free download, or the product link if there is no download), then the guide, and nothing after it - Julia asked on 19 Sep 2026 to stop signing off with 'See you in the garage' and her name, so replies end on the last link. Drop: the bare stan.store profile, the lnk.bio hub, and the 1:1 finish-plan link - Julia decided 19 Sep 2026 to keep Threads replies to the same two-link shape as the approved grit reply, even when there is room to spare, so there is one obvious click. Swap any long URL for its short form in 'short_links'. A PDF attached in LinkDM cannot be sent on Threads at all, so the link has to carry the whole job.

_template_note: A reel can carry its own 'template' next to its keyword. When present it is sent verbatim, so a reel can have as many links and as much wording as fits. Threads allows 500 characters for a reply and counts full URLs, so the script refuses to send anything longer rather than truncating it.
